# Jimwel Cruz — Full-Stack Developer and Web Team Lead

> Complete profile of Jimwel Cruz, a full-stack developer and web team lead based in the Philippines, building performant, user-friendly digital experiences with React, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, and Shopify since 2023.

## Profile

Jimwel Cruz is a full-stack developer and web team lead based in the Philippines. He has been building production web applications since 2023, working across the full stack from database design and API development to polished, responsive user interfaces. He helps clients and teams take products from ideation and wireframing through prototyping to final delivery, and he leads a development team while mentoring teammates along the way.

His focus is on performant, user-friendly digital experiences: fast load times, accessible markup, clean interfaces, and conversion-focused e-commerce flows. He is available for freelance work and open to discussing new opportunities.

## Services

### Full-Stack Development

Building complete, production-ready web applications from database to user interface. This includes designing database schemas, building RESTful APIs, implementing authentication and authorization, and delivering responsive front-ends with React and Next.js.

### E-commerce Development

Creating Shopify and custom online stores that convert visitors into customers. This covers theme customization, product catalog architecture, cart and checkout flows, payment integration, and performance tuning for stores that scale during traffic spikes.

### UI Implementation

Turning designs into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces using modern frameworks. Working from Figma or other design files, delivering component systems that match the intended visual design at every breakpoint.

### Performance Optimization

Improving load times and Lighthouse scores for a faster, smoother experience. This includes code splitting, image optimization, caching strategies, bundle analysis, and Core Web Vitals tuning.

### Accessibility Audits

Reviewing and fixing usability so everyone can navigate and use your website. Conducting WCAG-oriented reviews of keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, color contrast, and focus management, then implementing fixes.

### Responsive Design

Designing websites that look and perform equally well on all devices and screen sizes. Mobile-first layouts that preserve content and interaction quality from a 320px phone to a 4K monitor.
